services.name: World Record Balloon Stunt Show
services.desc: Highlands County Fair Association > Entertainment > World Record Balloon Stunt Show Get ready for nonstop laughs and jaw-dropping fun with James Johnson! This high-energy comic performer delivers a wild mix of rapid-fire comedy, interactive magic, daring stunts, music, and unforgettable audience moments. Every show is packed with surprises, from giant latex bubble creations and mind-bending tricks to juggling knives, escaping a straitjacket, riding towering unicycles, and more. It’s a fast-paced thrill ride that takes you from unstoppable laughter to edge-of-your-seat suspense. One thing’s guaranteed, you’ll leave smiling and talking about it long after the show
